# SR Enterprises

> SR Enterprises is an AC repair, AC service and AC installation company in Aurangabad (also known as Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar), Maharashtra, India. Operating since 2013 and run by founder Sharjeel. 4.9-star Google rating, ThreeBestRated.in Best AC Repair Aurangabad award (2025–Present), 90-day service warranty on repairs, genuine spare parts. Also repairs washing machines, refrigerators and microwave ovens.

Last updated: 26 October 2026

## Who we are
- Business name: SR Enterprises
- Founder and owner: Sharjeel
- Operating since: 2013 (over 10 years)
- Team: trained technicians serving Aurangabad and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
- Rating: 4.9/5 on Google Business Profile
- Recognition: ThreeBestRated.in Best AC Repair Aurangabad (2025–Present)

## Services and starting prices (INR)
Starting prices only. The final quote depends on the fault, appliance type and parts, and is confirmed before work begins.
- AC repair (split and window, all major brands): from ₹500
- AC deep clean (jet pump service): ₹799
- AC gas filling (nitrogen pressure test, leak detection, R22, R32, R410A): from ₹3,499
- AC installation (uninstallation and re-installation also available): ₹1,499
- Washing machine repair (front load, top load, fully and semi-automatic): from ₹349
- Refrigerator and fridge repair (single door, double door, frost-free): from ₹349
- Microwave oven repair (solo, grill, convection): quote on call

## Service area
Aurangabad and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, India, including Cidco, Garkheda, Waluj, Satara, Mukundwadi, N-1 to N-12, MIDC, Bajajnagar, Mondha, Sanjay Nagar, Baijipura, Osmanpura, Padegaon, Hudco Colony, Cantonment and Kranti Chowk.
